# evalkit

> evalkit is evals as code for LLM apps and agents. You write tasks and graders in a YAML suite,
> run them against a model (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic), a command, or an HTTP app, and fail CI
> when the pass rate or score regresses against a baseline. It ships as a Python package, a
> standalone executable, a container image, and a composite GitHub Action.

Key facts:

- CLI: `evalkit run | compare | validate | init | schema | cache`. Exit codes: 0 passed, 1 failed or regressed, 2 usage or config error.
- Graders: exact, contains, regex, json_schema, numeric, python, llm_judge.
- Providers: openai, anthropic, command, http, mock (offline and deterministic).
- GitHub Action: `uses: superintelligenceco/evalkit@v0.2.0` with `suite: evals.yaml`.
- Container: `docker run --rm ghcr.io/superintelligenceco/evalkit run evals.yaml`.

## Source

- [src/evalkit/cli.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/blob/main/src/evalkit/cli.py): command-line entry point
- [src/evalkit/config.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/blob/main/src/evalkit/config.py): suite schema (pydantic, strict)
- [src/evalkit/runner.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/blob/main/src/evalkit/runner.py): concurrency, retries, repeats, cache
- [src/evalkit/graders/](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/tree/main/src/evalkit/graders): built-in graders and the LLM judge
- [src/evalkit/providers/](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/tree/main/src/evalkit/providers): model and app targets
- [src/evalkit/compare.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/blob/main/src/evalkit/compare.py): regression gate
- [action.yml](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/evalkit/blob/main/action.yml): composite GitHub Action
